Alex’s day unfolded with a steady, cautious rhythm, marked by moderate stress and frequent interruptions that chipped away at his introverted reserves. Digital demands and screen fatigue added to cognitive load, while moderate autonomy and competence affirmation limited engagement spikes. Despite fatigue and a subdued mood, Alex managed to compartmentalize stress effectively, relying on brief solitude breaks to recharge, maintaining a dependable, if reserved, presence without major disruptions.
